meta.title: Palladium bio-recovery
meta.subtitle: Recovering a critical metal from dilute solution using a bacterial biocatalyst.
meta.boundary: Cradle-to-gate. Starts at the Pd-bearing leachate arriving on site, ends at refined Pd. Excludes production of the waste stream itself and any downstream use.

notes.title: Fixed equipment list
notes.text: The purchased equipment cost is a fixed list of eleven items sized for the design case. It does not change with throughput, feed concentration or recovery: doubling the plant leaves TCI at exactly the same value. Only the Lang factor moves the capital cost.

notes.title: Frozen LCIA basis
notes.text: The 18 impact categories use per-litre reagent burdens from the LCA study converted to per kg Pd with a frozen reference loading of 0.031926 kg Pd per m³ (31,322 L of solution per kg Pd). They are then scaled linearly by Tris molarity / 100 mM and NaCl molarity / 150 mM only. Throughput, feed concentration and recovery therefore never move the impact table, even though the mass balance and the electricity inventory respond to them.

notes.title: Climate figure excludes electricity
notes.text: The headline climate impact is the Tris-HCl plus NaCl precursor burden only. The electricity inventory is computed (and costed) but is not included in the impact table or the GWP benchmarks. gwp_electricity and gwp_with_elec are provided for comparison and are not part of the published figure.

notes.title: Tris precursor breakdown on a different basis
notes.text: The Tris-HCl precursor breakdown (hydroxylamine, formaldehyde, hydrogen, HCl) multiplies per-kg-Tris factors by the live Tris consumption per kg Pd from the mass balance, whereas the impact table uses the frozen 31,322 L/kg basis. The two Tris figures are not consistent with each other and the breakdown does not sum to the table value.

notes.title: Tax with no loss carry-forward
notes.text: Tax is max(0, EBIT) × rate in every year. A loss-making year pays no tax but the loss is not carried forward to reduce tax in later years.

notes.title: MSP and NPV are not exactly consistent
notes.text: NPV recovers the working capital as a cash inflow in the final year. The closed-form minimum selling price annualises the whole TCI over the project life and ignores that recovery, so the price at which NPV is exactly zero (msp_by_npv) is slightly lower than the reported MSP.

notes.title: Utility prices are constants
notes.text: Water ($1.5/m³) and electricity ($0.12/kWh) prices are fixed constants while reagent prices are user inputs. The energy intensities (3.5 kWh/m³ of solution and 800 kWh/kg Pd for calcination) are also fixed.

notes.title: Simple payback
notes.text: Payback is the simple ratio TCI / annual cash flow, undiscounted and ignoring the working-capital recovery. It is shown as "—" when the cash flow is not positive.

notes.title: Buffer recycle is costed but not credited
notes.text: A buffer recycle unit (nanofiltration + concentrator) is in the equipment list, but the mass balance consumes the full Tris-HCl and NaCl charge every year and sends the spent solution to effluent. No reagent recovery is credited in the inventory or the operating cost.

stages.title: Mass balance
stages.tryIt: Click the feed stream and drop the Pd concentration from 1.0 to 0.3 mM, then re-run. The Pd recovered falls by two thirds while the buffer and water flows do not move at all — the plant does the same work for a third of the product.

stages.title: Life cycle inventory
stages.tryIt: Look at Tris-HCl per kg Pd. It is measured in tonnes of buffer per kilogram of metal. Now halve the Tris concentration to 50 mM and re-run to see how directly the inventory follows it.

stages.title: Impact assessment
stages.tryIt: The buffer dominates. Set Tris to 25 mM and re-run — if the chemistry tolerated it, that one change would do more for the carbon footprint than switching to renewable electricity.

stages.title: Capital cost
stages.tryIt: The equipment list is fixed at this design, so only the Lang factor moves total capital. Try 3.0 against 4.0 and see the spread a single estimating convention creates.

stages.title: Operating cost & revenue
stages.tryIt: Compare the Tris-HCl cost against every other line. Then raise the biocatalyst reuse cycles from 10 to 30 in the mass balance step and re-run everything — reuse is the cheapest lever available.

stages.title: Profitability
stages.tryIt: Set the Pd price to $15,000/kg, near its historic low, and re-run. A process that depends on a volatile commodity price is a different investment proposition from one that does not.

scope.tryIt: Note that the functional unit is 1 kg of Pd recovered, not 1 m³ of solution treated. That single choice is why a dilute feed looks so bad here: the same buffer burden gets divided by far less metal.

interpret.tryIt: Feed concentration, Tris molarity and Pd price dominate everything else here. Two are process design choices and one is entirely outside your control.

throughput.label: Leachate throughput
throughput.source: Volume of Pd-bearing solution treated per year - spent catalyst leachate or e-waste liquor.

feed_pd.label: Pd concentration in feed
feed_pd.source: Pd(II) in the incoming liquor. 1 mM is about 106 mg/L - typical of a dilute secondary stream.

recovery.label: Recovery efficiency
recovery.source: Fraction of the incoming Pd reduced onto the biocatalyst. Shewanella systems report 90-99%.

tris_mm.label: Tris-HCl buffer
tris_mm.source: Buffer strength needed to hold pH during bioreduction. The single largest environmental burden.

nacl_mm.label: NaCl
nacl_mm.source: Ionic strength adjustment for cell viability.

biocat_cycles.label: Biocatalyst reuse cycles
biocat_cycles.source: How many batches one biomass charge survives before replacement.

biocat_loading.label: Single-pass biocatalyst loading
biocat_loading.source: kg dry cells per kg Pd recovered in a single pass (BIOCAT_KG_PER_KG_PD_SP).

elec_per_m3.label: Electricity per m³ of solution
elec_per_m3.source: Pumping, mixing and buffer handling: 3.5 kWh per m³ of solution treated (ELEC_PER_M3).

calc_kwh_per_kg.label: Calcination electricity per kg Pd
calc_kwh_per_kg.source: Electric calcination furnace, 800 kWh per kg Pd (CALC_KWH_PER_KG_PD).

lca_pd_loading.label: LCA reference Pd loading
lca_pd_loading.source: kg Pd recovered per m³ of process solution in the LCA study; converts per-litre burdens to per kg Pd.

tris_mm_ref.label: Tris molarity at LCA design
tris_mm_ref.source: Tris-HCl concentration at which the per-litre burdens were computed.

nacl_mm_ref.label: NaCl molarity at LCA design
nacl_mm_ref.source: NaCl concentration at which the per-litre burdens were computed.

gwp_elec.label: Grid electricity GWP
gwp_elec.source: kg CO2e per kWh, UK grid average. Not used by the published climate figure (see note).

gwp_ipa.label: Benchmark: IPA 2022 global primary Pd
gwp_ipa.source: International Platinum Group Metals Association 2022 global average, kg CO2e per kg Pd.

gwp_za.label: Benchmark: Ecoinvent South Africa
gwp_za.source: Ecoinvent primary Pd, South African mines.

gwp_ru.label: Benchmark: Ecoinvent Russia
gwp_ru.source: Ecoinvent primary Pd, Russian mines (Ni-Cu by-product).

lang.label: Lang factor
lang.source: Total installed cost divided by purchased equipment cost. 3.6-4.2 for solid-fluid plants.

wc_frac.label: Working capital fraction of TIC
wc_frac.source: Working capital taken as 10% of total installed cost.

tris_price.label: Tris-HCl price
tris_price.source: $/kg of Tris-HCl. Bulk buffer chemistry is expensive at this scale.

biocat_price.label: Biocatalyst production cost
biocat_price.source: $/kg dry cell mass, covering fermentation, harvest and purification.

pd_price.label: Pd market price
pd_price.source: $/kg of palladium. Historically volatile - it has traded from $15k to $95k/kg.

ins_frac.label: Insurance & property tax, fraction of TIC

discount.label: Discount rate
discount.source: Cost of capital used to discount future cash flows.

life.label: Project life
life.source: Operating years over which the investment is judged.

dep.label: Depreciation life
dep.source: Straight-line depreciation period for the installed plant.

lcia_cf.label: ReCiPe 2016 Midpoint (H) burdens per litre of process solution at the LCA design (100 mM Tris, 150 mM NaCl)

tris_precursors.label: Tris-HCl precursor GWP per kg Tris-HCl (LCA Figure 2)

gwp_vs_ipa.label: GWP vs IPA 2022 global primary Pd

gwp_electricity.label: GWP from electricity (not in published figure)

gwp_with_elec.label: GWP including electricity (not in published figure)

tris_precursor_gwp.label: Tris precursor GWP per kg Pd

pec.label: Purchased equipment cost
pec.basis: Sum of the fixed equipment list

opex_total.label: Total operating cost
opex_total.expr: cost_tris + cost_nacl + cost_water + cost_biocat + cost_acid + cost_elec + cost_steam + cost_cooling + cost_labour + cost_maint + cost_ins + cost_overhead + cost_waste + cost_qaqc

cash_flows.label: Cash flow series (year 0 … T)
cash_flows.basis: Year 0 = −TCI; years 1..T = CF, working capital recovered in year T

msp.label: Minimum selling price
msp.basis: ((annualised TCI − D) ÷ (1 − tax) + OPEX + D) ÷ Pd recovered

positive_feed.message: Throughput and Pd concentration must be positive.

cycles_min.message: Reuse cycles below 1 are treated as 1.

lca.basis: Single product: every burden is assigned to the Pd recovered. Reagent burdens are per litre of solution on the frozen LCA basis.

tea.basis: Single revenue stream: all costs are carried by the Pd product.

feed_vs_tris.label: MSP against feed concentration and Tris
